SELECT sync_changes.revision, sync_changes.user_id, sync_changes.cat_id, sync_changes.created_at 
FROM sync_changes 
WHERE sync_changes.user_id = $1::UUID AND sync_changes.revision > $2::INTEGER ORDER BY sync_changes.revision 
 LIMIT $3::INTEGER

SELECT cats.id, cats.user_id, cats.client_id, cats.payload, cats.analysis, cats.photo_key, cats.photo_hash, cats.photo_content_type, cats.client_updated_at, cats.updated_by_device, cats.deleted_at, cats.created_at, cats.server_updated_at 
FROM cats 
WHERE cats.id IN ($1::UUID, $2::UUID)

SELECT sync_changes.cat_id, max(sync_changes.revision) AS max_1 
FROM sync_changes 
WHERE sync_changes.cat_id IN ($1::UUID, $2::UUID) GROUP BY sync_changes.cat_id

SELECT cat_photos.id, cat_photos.cat_id, cat_photos.kind, cat_photos.storage_key, cat_photos.content_hash, cat_photos.content_type, cat_photos.status, cat_photos.analysis, cat_photos.deleted_at, cat_photos.created_at, cat_photos.updated_at 
FROM cat_photos 
WHERE cat_photos.cat_id IN ($1::UUID, $2::UUID) AND cat_photos.kind IN ($3::VARCHAR, $4::VARCHAR, $5::VARCHAR, $6::VARCHAR) AND cat_photos.deleted_at IS NULL
